description: Ready fact sentences for a match or team, most important first: form, streaks, records, head-to-head, table and stakes; after a match the story and the runs it ended. Each fact: type, importance, text (lang de, es, it or fr). summary: the top ones as one paragraph. Facts only, no predictions. The same facts as get_match_briefing and get_team_briefing without the data blocks. Insights feature.

kind.description: match or team (tennis: a player); a league: get_league_facts

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

sport.description: sport (default soccer; not cricket or table-tennis)

name: get_facts
